key_provisions_or_claims: France's withdrawal of BR1C helium gas cylinders by Xinchang Burong Machinery made before 31 Oct 2019 is justified
Cylinders lacked conformity assessment, had incorrect markings and a cracked weld
Decision addressed to the Member States
Adopted under Article 31(1) of Directive 2010/35/EU after consultation of Member States
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/834 finds justified France's market withdrawal of non-compliant helium gas cylinders made by Xinchang Burong Machinery, which lacked conformity assessment, had defective markings and a cracked weld. It concerns transportable pressure equipment and is unrelated to AI or robotics.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/834 of 25 May 2022 on a measure taken by France concerning the withdrawal from the market of certain gas cylinders manufactured by Xinchang Burong Machinery Co. Ltd before 31 October 2019
